The official OpenAI deprecations page is at developers.openai.com/docs/deprecations, but the search only returned fragments of it. Most of the dates below come from third-party guides, so verify them on the official page before relying on them.

**Confirmed on the official page (as excerpted):**
- Older GPT Image models were announced June 2, 2026 for removal from the API on December 1, 2026. Recommended replacement is gpt-image-2 for gpt-image-1-mini, gpt-image-1.5, and chatgpt-image-latest. On June 2, 2026, we notified developers using older GPT Image models of their deprecation and removal from the API on December 1, 2026.
- gpt-5.2-chat-latest and gpt-5.3-chat-latest shut down August 10, 2026, with gpt-5.5 as the replacement. Aug 10, 2026 | gpt-5.2-chat-latest | gpt-5.5
- Fine-tuning access is narrowing. Creating new fine-tuning jobs was cut off for organizations without prior fine-tuning activity starting May 7, 2026, and on July 2, 2026 it was also cut off for organizations that have not run inference on a fine-tuned model in the past 60 days. Creating fine-tuning jobs is no longer available to organizations that have not run inference on a fine-tuned model in the past 60 days.

**From third-party guides (not verified against the official page here):**
- A July 23, 2026 shutdown covered 15 model entries, including gpt-5-chat-latest, gpt-5.1-codex, and several audio, realtime, and search previews. Access to these models will be shut down in the API on the following dates
- The Assistants API is listed to shut down August 26, 2026, with the Responses API and Conversations API named as replacements. the Assistants API shuts down August 26, 2026 with the Responses API and Conversations API as the named replacements
- Sora 2 and the Videos API are listed for September 24, 2026, with no replacement. Sora 2 and the entire Videos API retire September 24, 2026 with no replacement listed.
- The largest cluster is October 23, 2026, which reportedly includes gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4-turbo, o1, o3-mini, o4-mini, and gpt-image-1. One source says gpt-4, gpt-3.5-turbo, gpt-4-turbo, gpt-4o-2024-05-13, o1, o1-pro, o3-mini, o4-mini, gpt-4.1-nano, gpt-image-1, and their fine-tuned variants all retire. Replacements are mostly the GPT-5.6 tiers and gpt-image-2.
- Later dates reported: GPT-5 and o3 snapshots on December 11, 2026, and the legacy audio and realtime family on January 20, 2027. Fine-tuning job creation for existing customers is reportedly ending January 6, 2027.

**Caveats:** Sources disagree in places. One guide describes the Oct 23 batch as retiring GPT-4 with gpt-5.6-sol as the replacement, and the wording of the batch varies across sites. One third-party page also has encoding errors. Several of these dates are now past or close, as today is October 16, 2026, so the official page should be checked before any migration decisions.
